subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo — timezone / DST coordination
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@astramed.com.au>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo — timezone / DST coordination

Hi Sophie — great to connect last week. We’d love to get a live demo of the Redwood Inference platform for the AstraMed team next week. I wanted to propose a couple of slots that try to accommodate Melbourne and our US/EMEA folks: 

• Monday Nov 02, 09:00 AEDT / Sunday Nov 01, 22:00 PDT / 01:00 UTC (next day)
• Wednesday Nov 04, 15:00 AEDT / 16:00 UTC / 11:00 EDT
• Saturday Nov 07, 10:00 AEDT / Friday Nov 06, 19:00 PDT (note US switches off DST Nov 7)

We included Monica (customer success) and Vivek (sales lead) on cc to help align follow-ups. If any of those are rough, tell us preferred windows and we’ll shift. I’ve attached a provisional calendar invite (calendar_invite.ics) and a short DST conversion note (DST-conversion-reference.pdf) since the Nov changeover tends to cause confusion.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
(redwood.ai)

(attachment: calendar_invite.ics) (attachment: DST-conversion-reference.pdf)
From: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@astramed.com.au>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ken Ito <ken.ito@medlink.jp>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:23:00 +11:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Redwood demo — timezone / DST coordination

Hi Jonas — thanks for the options. A quick note on local times: Melbourne moved to daylight saving earlier this month, so our local clocks are +11 from UTC (AEDT). Also, our clinical team prefers mornings (08:30–11:30 AEDT).

Of your suggested slots, Nov 02 at 09:00 AEDT works well. Nov 07 is tricky because I worry about the US side — I think the US changeover on Nov 7 will flip some clients back an hour and could cause people to join at the wrong time if we send the invite now.

Can we lock in Mon Nov 02 09:00 AEDT? If you think Nov 09 is safer (after the US switches time), we’re flexible but prefer morning Melbourne time.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Miller
Programs Lead, AstraMed Pty Ltd
Sophie.miller@astramed.com.au

---
Note: cc’d Ken Ito from our Tokyo office — he may join for the technical Q&A.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@astramed.com.au>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Redwood demo — timezone / DST coordination

Thanks Sophie — good catch on the DST risk. To be explicit: 

- Mon Nov 02 09:00 AEDT = Mon Nov 02 22:00 UTC-11? (sorry for the confusion) — easier is to use UTC: Nov 02 22:00 UTC would be poor for our EMEA folks.

- The US DST change is scheduled for Sun Nov 07 at 02:00 local time (clocks fall back 1h) — that will make any invite sent before Nov 7 tricky for attendees in PDT/PST.

Proposal: move the demo to Tue Nov 09 at 01:00 UTC which would be Tue Nov 09 12:00 AEDT (Melbourne lunch window) and Mon Nov 08 20:00 PST — that avoids both changeovers and lands in a midday window for you. Laura, Monica — are you available Nov 09 01:00 UTC for a 45–60m demo?

If Nov 09 doesn’t work, we can lock Mon Nov 02 at 09:00 AEDT now, but we’ll need to re-send invites post-DST change with clear timezone labels. I’ll defer to Laura on runbook/SE availability.

Jonas
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Redwood demo — timezone / DST coordination

On Fri, Oct 30, 2026 at 10:05 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposal: move the demo to Tue Nov 09 at 01:00 UTC which would be Tue Nov 09 12:00 AEDT (Melbourne lunch window) and Mon Nov 08 20:00 PST — that avoids both changeovers and lands in a midday window for you.

That time works for me. I’ll plan for SE-side a 30–40 minute product walkthrough focused on: model routing, latency/cost tradeoffs, and security controls. If Ken wants a deeper technical Q&A, we can add 15–20 minutes at the end.

Two small asks: 
• Can you confirm which time we put on the invite (I recommend using UTC + local times in parentheses and sending the invite after Nov 7 so calendar apps pick up the correct offsets).
• I’ll attach a brief slide (SE-runbook.pdf) with the demo agenda and endpoints we’ll hit.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: SE-runbook.pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Confirmed: Redwood demo for AstraMed — Nov 09 01:00 UTC (updated invite to follow)

Hi Sophie — thanks for flagging preferences. We’ve tentatively scheduled Tue Nov 09, 01:00 UTC / 12:00 AEDT for the demo to avoid the US DST flip. I’m sending a new calendar invite (will post after Nov 07) with both UTC and AEDT times in the title to avoid client-side conversion errors.

Quick checklist for the session:
- Attendees: AstraMed clinical + infra (Sophie, Ken) + Redwood (Jonas, Laura, Monica)
- Objective: live walkthrough + 15m technical Q&A
- Prep: SE-runbook.pdf (attached), please share any specific data/privacy questions ahead of time.

(attachment: calendar_invite.ics)
Best,
Monica
